rules.statement: A cause of action for damages arising from the delict of setting the law in motion is prescribed within 2 years of the arrest.
rules.supporting_quote: Did the Court of Appeal fall into substantial error by completely ignoring the provisions of Section 9 of the Prescription Ordinance? Moreover, in terms of section 9 of the Prescription Ordinance, action for damages should be filed within 2 years of the arrest.
